requirement_summary: Create, save and reopen local documents
Keyboard entry and editing of mathematical expressions
Pen input with selection, movement and erasure
Convert selected handwriting with correction before acceptance
Render typeset math; preserve editable incomplete input
Capture selected row or region as a discrete input object
Duplicate steps and edit copies independently
Preserve ordered mathematical steps and explanatory text
Undo and redo edits
Export typeset PDF without separate LaTeX rewriting
Structured Math IR; at least 95% valid conversion of recognized supported inputs
/rref; at least 99% deterministic correctness
/matmul; at least 99% correctness
/derivative; at least 99% correctness against SymPy
/integral and /simplify; at least 99% correctness
Matrix row operations with operation shown
Substitute selected variable or expression while preserving original step
Choose exported steps and scratch work without deleting saved content
AI checks, hints and explanations; accept changes explicitly
Commands on recognized Math IR; gated by reliable conversion
Preserve and navigate alternative solution branches
Transfer documents using shared file format
Linked 2D visualizations update with selected expression
User-defined commands chaining supported operations
Broader complex handwriting recognition; improved ExpRate with minimal correction
Startup under 1 second; navigation within 250 ms
Non-chat LLM latency under 300 ms
95% of LLM responses relevant to context and action
All mathematical data losslessly convertible to LaTeX
Crash recovery loses no more than 10 seconds of work
At least 95% of export test documents free of missing or clipped content and ordering errors
Preserve work and show recoverable error within 2 seconds after AI failure detected
Core workflows keyboard-operable; evaluate applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria
